verdict.rationale: A data-training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair question for an AI compute and inference platform with Public Endpoints, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no policy, setting, or guarantee that customer data is excluded from AI model training. Multi-tenant container isolation and SOC 2/ISO partner certifications are adjacent security controls and do not address training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
